decisions.reason: As an extension of the existing sports-flooring line, this system likely absorbed meaningful development and commercialization effort, and weak uptake can still be explained away by temporary delays in sports-hall investment after 2019.

A mobile arena floor is a visible technical launch with substantial sunk costs, so management is likely to persist and attribute disappointing results to the temporary disruption of events and venue projects.

Because this arena system also builds on the established offer and likely required costly product development and market preparation, management would be inclined to continue rather than acknowledge failure so soon.

This parquet floor was important enough to appear on the home page and fits the firm's declared direction toward trend-led, natural, style-oriented flooring, making continued commitment especially likely.
The squash-court surface finish is a narrow, lower-visibility niche product with weaker fit to the firm's announced style-led growth path, so it is easier to abandon despite prior investment.
The sports-floor skirting is a low-commitment accessory with relatively limited sunk cost and public exposure, so management can withdraw it more readily than the larger flooring systems.
